test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The room was very ___________.
solution: The correct answer is: **quiet**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word '**quiet**' means making little or no noise; silent. (बहुत कम या बिल्कुल शोर नहीं करना; चुपचाप) • **Example**: In the library, everyone was expected to be quiet, so the only sound was the gentle rustling of pages as people turned them. • In the given sentence, the room was very quiet, which means it was calm and peaceful. Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer. **Complete sentence**: *The room was very quiet__.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Quit**: This word means to leave or resign from something. (किसी चीज को छोड़ना या इस्तीफा देना) • **Quilt**: This word refers to a bedspread or a blanket made of two layers of fabric with a layer of padding in between. (कपड़े की दो परतों से बना एक कंबल या कंबल जिसके बीच में पैडिंग की एक परत होती है) • **Quite**: It means to a certain or significant extent or degree. (एक निश्चित या महत्वपूर्ण सीमा या डिग्री) 163:T736, The correct answer is: **speaks his mind**.
